question: Is FP_ELEMENTWISE_PAR_MIN too low (spawn overhead) or the .min(8) worker cap too low (memory-level parallelism) for the UNARY witness map at 1M f64?
comparison_class: FP-vs-FP setting sweep (NOT a vs-incumbent row) - picks a default; the vs-pandas ratio is measured separately.
method: ONE process, ONE ELF, per-thread policy override installed outside the clock, arms interleaved ABBA against the shipped default (8, 200000) for 15 rounds after 3 warmup pairs. The (8,200000) arm IS the A/A null.
gate: A run is REFUSED unless its A/A null median is within 2% of unity. A candidate certifies only if its paired-ratio 95% CI excludes unity AND |log effect| exceeds twice the null's log margin.
